title: A smooth finite modification of a reduced curve
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and let $X$ be a reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] separated scheme of finite type over $k$ with $\dim X\le1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then there exist a separated scheme $X^
u$ of finite type over $k$ with $\dim X^
u\le1$ which is smooth over $k$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], a finite morphism of $k$-schemes $
u:X^
u	o X$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and a dense open subscheme $X'\subseteq X$ such that $
u$ restricts to an isomorphism $
u^{-1}(X')	o X'$. (One may take for $
u$ the normalization of $X$, the disjoint union of the normalizations [def-sc-normalization] of the irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $X$ with their reduced structure.)

source.place: Varieties, Lemma 0BXR (lemma-normalization-locally-algebraic: nu finite, X^nu a disjoint union of normal irreducible schemes, nu birational for X reduced) and Lemma 0B8Y (lemma-regular-point-on-curve: normal one-dimensional over a perfect field is smooth), as used in Etale Cohomology, proof of Lemma 0A3Q (lemma-somewhat-easier)

proof.text: The proved private component-cover helper uses isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType, finite_irreducibleComponents_of_isNoetherian and Fintype.equivFin to enumerate components without repetitions. Construct each component as the subscheme of its vanishing ideal. Source IdealSheafData.isReduced_subscheme_vanishingIdeal gives reducedness; its irreducible underlying closed set gives integrality. Closed immersion and dimension bounds follow from Mathlib subschemeι and IsInducing.topologicalKrullDim_le.

For every integral component use normalization in its function field. The source lem-sc-normalization-exists declarations give finite map, dimension preservation and an isomorphism over a nonempty open (dense by irreducibility). Normalization stalks are integrally closed domains by lem-weil-pbc-normalization-normal-stalks; compute integrally closed stalks of the function-field spectrum using localization. Finite type over k gives local Noetherianity. Apply IsRegular.of_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk for dimension at most one, then source smooth_of_isRegular over the perfect field k. This proves integral_curve_modification without sorry, for both dimensions zero and one.

Choose the component normalizations simultaneously and take their coproduct. Compose with the closed immersions. The source IsFinite.sigmaDesc instance proves finiteness for the finite family, using closed-immersion finiteness and composition. Source-local smoothness (IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc) proves smoothness. Bound dimension with topologicalKrullDim_le_of_iSup_eq_top and the sigmaOpenCover: each opensRange is isomorphic to its summand via isoOfRangeEq. The sole remaining theorem lem-weil-pbc-dense-open-component-modifications supplies the dense open and isomorphism of the coproduct map.

Register finiteness of the assembled map locally. Mathlib typeclass instances for finite maps and composition supply separatedness, local finite type and quasi-compactness of the structure morphism over k. Combine these with dimension, smoothness, finiteness and the dense-open witness using conjunction and existential constructors. The empty case is included by the empty component index and empty coproduct.

split_report.summary: Split in six steps following Stacks 0BXR/0B8Y/035P/0BAJ as used in 0A3Q: empty case and irreducible components with reduced structure (integral, separated finite type, dim <= 1); dimension-one components normalized via lem-sc-normalization-properties (a) finite, dim preserved, (c) smooth (k perfect), (b) iso over a nonempty normal open from lem-fin-dense-normal-open; dimension-zero components are Spec k (new unsplit lem-weil-pbc-zero-dim-integral-point) and are kept with the identity; assembly of X^nu = disjoint union with nu finite (new Mathlib leaves lem-weil-pbc-finite-composition, lem-weil-pbc-finite-coproduct), separated finite type (new leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-over-separated-finite-type), smooth (new leaf lem-weil-pbc-smooth-coproduct), dim <= 1; the dense open X' = disjoint union of U_i minus the other components, and nu an isomorphism over it (elementary, written out). Added def-pc-reduced-scheme and def-weil-irreducible-components to stmt_deps. Off-route statements used as tools: lem-fin-dense-normal-open (unit sk-prop-a1-kummer) and lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-finite-components (unit sk-prop-sf-cbc).
